# Overlay

> Overlay is the control plane for AI employees: one workspace to create,
> deploy, and manage every AI agent in one place. Bring your own agents
> (Codex, Claude Code, Hermes) or run Overlay's own, and put them to work in
> one shared workspace on the web and desktop. Built by LayerNorm Inc.
> Open source under AGPL-3.0, with hosted and self-hosted options.

Overlay unifies AI agents: a single roster, shared context and memory,
per-agent computers, schedules and durable automations, spend and
permission controls, and audit trails, with a free tier that requires no
card.

## Product

- [Home](https://overlay.works/home): product overview, the control plane for AI employees
- [Pricing](https://overlay.works/pricing): free tier and paid plans

- [Manifesto](https://overlay.works/manifesto): why AI should amplify human potential
- [Self-hosting](https://overlay.works/self-hosting): run Overlay on infrastructure you control
